critical_code_review_comments: AudioCallPlayer.jsx: line offset estimation is purely character-length based — acceptable proxy for transcript highlighting but may drift on real audio; for better sync consider storing per-line timestamps from the TTS generation step.
server.py _generate_demo_call_audio concatenates raw MP3 frames with b''.join — this works for browser playback (as confirmed) but is not a proper container merge; fine for demo purposes.

No automated invalidation of /app/backend/audio_cache/demo_call.mp3 if DEMO_CALL_SCRIPT changes — devs must manually delete the file. Consider hashing the script and naming the cache file accordingly.

Pricing.jsx: Pro tier uses md:-translate-y-4 which is only elevated on md+; on mobile the 'MOST POPULAR' card sits inline between the other two — works but could be reordered to top on mobile for conversion.
AudioCallPlayer shadow uses fixed 16px offset which on very small viewports can cause horizontal bleed — section overflow-hidden keeps it safe.
